scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.desktop:prepare: npm run build && node desktop/prepare.mjs && npm install --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop: npm run desktop:prepare && npm start --prefix desktop
scripts.desktop:win: npm run desktop:prepare && npm run dist:win --prefix desktop
scripts.android:sync: npm run build -w client && npm exec --prefix client -- cap sync android
